Bone-Conducted Call.name: Bone-Conducted Call
Bone-Conducted Call.description: The user pitches their voice so its vibration carries through rubble, doors and smoke to people within half a block, who feel the words in their ribs and jaw even over sirens or ringing ears. Frightened or buried survivors can follow the user's directions to a safe exit and tap back on pipes or stone to mark their spot. It reaches half the distance of a pure sound user's call and leaves the user's throat raw. Strain: moderate.
